CREDITS + ABOUT
CC FILMS, LLC

Jamie Foster (Jessica Dawn Willis) is a once-prominent internet personality whose desperation to remain relevant intensifies as her numbers dwindle and she is given an ultimatum by her boss and ruthless aunt Camilla Moore (Danielle Harris) to boost her views or forfeit her show.

Looking to achieve success at any cost, Jamie invites a mysterious stranger onto her show after they contact her and allude to being responsible for the disappearances of four other internet personalities. Camilla's cold neglect toward Jamie, and the deep dive into the missing women, causes a slow unraveling as Jamie's dark past reveals itself in the present, turning over secrets thought long-buried.

As the darkness threatens to consume Jamie, her single hope of living in the light resides with Dr. Jonathan Myers (Michael Ironside), a psychiatrist with his own mysterious past who previously survived an encounter with Jamie's stalker.

CC Films, the banner led by executive producer Carlos R. Cortez, presents its debut feature release. Prior to launching CC Films, Cortez served as executive producer on the 2023 feature A Woman Under the Stage.

CC FILMS AND ABSENTIA PICTURES IN ASSOCIATION WITH HIGHLAND MYST ENTERTAINMENT AND ALPHA CHANNELFILMS PRESENT MARROW.

MARROW WORLD PREMIERE ARCHIVE

Marrow made its world premiere at the USA Film Festival Texas Filmmakers Showcase on February 17, 2026 at the Angelika Film Center in Dallas. This gallery collects the premiere-night photo archive for fans, collaborators, press, and festival attendees looking for official CC Films materials.

The archive is intentionally presented as a full contact sheet: red carpet moments, theater arrivals, cast and crew appearances, stage remarks, audience energy, and post-screening documentation. Photos are credited to Tony Grimes.
